landmark: Port Authority Bus Terminal / Midtown Bus Terminal

reference.use: Visual reference only; pixels are not embedded in the game. Sign artwork and structural details are authored in native code.

sources.publisher: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
sources.supports: Terminal spans West 40th–42nd Streets between Eighth and Ninth Avenues.
North Wing expansion and diagonal girder facade.
Unchanged NYC3D geometry and exact source-triangle collision.

placement.method: Eighth Avenue and West 42nd Street planes ray-fitted to the bundled NYC3D collision triangles. Source plane intersection identifies the northeast corner. Thin detail layers sit 0.18 metres outside the source walls; fit residual is under 0.013 metres. Roof height is constrained by original source triangles.

scope: North Wing corner plus the Eighth Avenue south frontage, all within existing bundled city coverage. No additional Manhattan tiles, source-mesh edits, vehicles, interiors or gameplay systems.
approximations: Street-level detail dimensions, storefront finish, canopy shapes, brick supports and bollard spacing are visual interpretations of the photograph.
Blue construction wrap is an authored interpretation of the reference, not a live sign survey.
South frontage finish is generalized to continue the same terminal material palette.
The historical NYC building shell does not represent recessed concourse interiors or a traversable West 41st Street vehicle portal.
verification: Source-wall/roof fitting, walking and running routes, corner turn, covered entrances, cylindrical obstacle separation and actual Cesium initialization are checked offline. WebGL/browser visual verification unavailable.
